source.author: verg
source.text: Haec Damon: vos, quae responderit Alphesiboeus, dicite, Pierides; non omnia possumus omnes.
source.text_original: Haec Damon: vos, quae responderit Alphesiboeus, / dicite, Pierides; non omnia possumus omnes.
source.text_english: Thus Damon spoke: tell, O Pierides, what Alphesiboeus replied; not all of us can do everything.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Hoc totum dico, quod non omnia possumus omnes: rarusque aut nullus est divitum, qui in omni substantia sua paria universa possideat.
reuse.text_original: Hoc totum dico, quod non omnia possumus omnes: rarusque aut nullus est divitum, qui in omni substantia sua paria universa possideat.
reuse.text_english: I say all this because not all of us can do everything: and there is hardly any rich man, or none at all, who possesses everything equally in all his possessions.
